cards.streamingPlaceholder: The UI appears once this message finishes
cards.legacyWarning: Compatibility mode: this card can read and write browser storage and reach the host page. Only use it for cards you trust.
cards.runtimeHint: Frontend cards run in a sandboxed iframe: no host DOM, cookies or local storage — every capability goes through a controlled bridge.
cards.runtimeSwitchHint: Same switch as Appearance → Body; stored on this device.
cards.externalLibsHint: FontAwesome icons and Tailwind, which many cards assume exist. Turn off for offline or network-free setups (cards lose icons).
cards.scriptsHint: Character-bound and global scripts run in hidden iframes — that's how framework scripts like MVU get loaded.
cards.trustHint: The default applies to every card; characters with their own level are listed below.

trustDetail.strict: Only NewTavern's bundled libraries; no network and no external resources at all. Safest, but cards that rely on a CDN will miss pieces.
trustDetail.standard: Can load https scripts, styles, images and fonts; network requests only reach NewTavern itself (external APIs must go through the host proxy). Recommended.
trustDetail.trusted: Standard plus the card may call any address directly. Reserve it for cards you wrote or fully trust.
trustDetail.legacy-unsafe: Also grants same-origin access so old cards relying on window.parent / localStorage keep working. This gives up isolation — last resort only.

cards.mvuHint: Parses <UpdateVariable> commands out of the model's output into this message's variable snapshot. Branches and rerolls each keep their own set.
cards.mvuSwitchHint: With this off, variable tables stay readable and writable — they just stop following the model's output.
cards.ejsSwitchHint: Runs <% … %> in lore books, presets and character cards before sending (ST-Prompt-Template compatible, sandboxed; a block running over 200ms is stopped and left as-is). Template blocks in chat messages are removed, not run.

mvuExtra.keepTitle: Keep variable snapshots for the last N messages
mvuExtra.keepHint: 0 keeps everything. Above 0, snapshots on older messages are cleared to save space; recalculation starts from the nearest full snapshot.

intro.character: Say how you'd like to change this card — fill in the definition, shift the tone, add greetings. Every change is listed so you can pick what to keep.
intro.preset: Say how you'd like to tune this preset — which prompt to rewrite, what rule to add, how to move the samplers.
intro.lorebook: Say what this lorebook is missing — new entries, better keywords, merging duplicates.

character: Split the description into looks / personality / history
Write two more greetings in different moods
Run a test turn and check the voice
preset: Add a rule against speaking for the user
How long is the assembled prompt?
lorebook: List all entries and find duplicate keywords
Write one entry for each major location
